title: Murder Mystery Drag Show in Gastown Downtown Vancouver
includes: Guests are provided with escape game style puzzles during the first intermission - can you solve the puzzles and collect the clues?
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Show Info:
Check Listings for Dates - this show takes place once a month on a Friday night with a rotating series of 4 different shows. 

Murder is a Drag, is a fun and fast-paced show with killer drag performances while a murder mystery unfolds. Guests from all over the world get a glimpse into local entertainment and make new friends while solving puzzles together and helping our detective solve a murder. Guests may be offered small roles in the show (participation 100% optional) and everyone gets a chance to guess the murderer. This is not cheesy dinner theatre, it is campy and cheeky fun. 

Check the dates and pricing for information about the show.
